## Summary

Move `data/repo/SettingsRepository.kt`, `update/UpdateRepository.kt` and `data/repo/
CoachRepository.kt` into `shared/src/commonMain`, replacing each one's `Context`-derived DataStore
delegate or `context.filesDir`/`context.assets` file access with an `expect`/`actual` seam. None of
the three touches Room, so this issue does not require #212: it only needs the `data/model`
types #210 already moved (`CoachBundle`, `CoachJson`, `WorkoutTemplate`). `content/
ContentSyncRepository.kt` stays out of scope: unlike `UpdateRepository.kt`, it genuinely needs
`context.filesDir` for animation-file writes and a YAML parse, and no issue in this manifest yet
owns turning it into a shared implementation (#216 gives it a one-method port interface
without moving its body).

## Why

"DataStore KMP" is one of the four things the client port moves into the shared module, per
[spec §3.5](https://github.com/Senkichi/swole/blob/28afd7dad9e040760ba9cc045d7306b286068a1b/docs/superpowers/specs/2026-09-17-swole-public-release-plan-design.md#35-client) and
[spec W2](https://github.com/Senkichi/swole/blob/28afd7dad9e040760ba9cc045d7306b286068a1b/docs/superpowers/specs/2026-09-17-swole-public-release-plan-design.md#w2--multiplatform-port-billing-launch)
item 2.2 ("shared module: Room KMP, DataStore KMP, OkHttp → Ktor, the Kotlin twins, session/sync
logic"). `CoachRepository`'s bundle-file persistence rides along with it: it is the same
`Context`-scoped-storage shape as the two DataStore repositories, just backed by a plain file
instead of a `Preferences` store, and moving it separately later would leave the coach-bundle read
path Android-only well past the point the rest of the client compiles for both platforms.

## Fix shape

1. Move `data/repo/SettingsRepository.kt` (37 lines) to
   `shared/src/commonMain/kotlin/dev/senki/swole/data/repo/SettingsRepository.kt`, taking the
   `DataStore<Preferences>` as a plain constructor parameter (drop the `@Inject`/`@ApplicationContext`
   secondary constructor and the `private val Context.dataStore by preferencesDataStore(...)`
   delegate; keep the `serverUrl`/`token` `Flow` properties and the `DEFAULT_SERVER_URL` companion
   constant unchanged). Add `expect fun createSettingsDataStore(): DataStore<Preferences>`;
   `shared/src/androidMain/.../SettingsDataStore.kt`: `actual fun createSettingsDataStore():
   DataStore<Preferences>` using `PreferenceDataStoreFactory.createWithPath` (Room/DataStore KMP's
   documented Android path helper) pointed at the app's files dir with name `"settings"`,
   preserving today's on-disk file name so an upgrading install's existing preferences load
   unchanged; `shared/src/iosMain/.../SettingsDataStore.kt`: `actual fun
   createSettingsDataStore(): DataStore<Preferences>` using the same
   `PreferenceDataStoreFactory.createWithPath` API pointed at a path under `NSHomeDirectory()` —
   this target is never executed on the Windows CI runner today, so this actual is unverified by
   any run in this PR. `swole/app/mobile/src/main/kotlin/dev/senki/swole/di/` gains a small
   `@Provides` function (in the existing DI module that today provides `SettingsRepository`, or a
   new small module beside it) supplying the Android `DataStore<Preferences>` via
   `createSettingsDataStore()` and constructing the shared `SettingsRepository` from it, keeping
   Hilt injection working for `mobile`'s other consumers (`di/SettingsRepository`'s current
   consumers are unaffected by this constructor-shape change since Hilt still resolves the same
   type).
2. Move `update/UpdateRepository.kt` (67 lines) to
   `shared/src/commonMain/kotlin/dev/senki/swole/update/UpdateRepository.kt`, mirroring step 1:
   per #209's inventory, `UpdateRepository`'s only Android dependency is the
   `Context.updaterStore` DataStore delegate its `@Inject` secondary constructor uses — its public
   API (`available: Flow<UpdateUi?>`, `checkForUpdate(api: SyncApi, nowMs: Long)`) and the
   `UpdateUi` data class it returns are already plain Kotlin. Drop `@Inject`/`@ApplicationContext`;
   keep the plain primary constructor `UpdateRepository(store: DataStore<Preferences>,
   installedVersionCode: Int)` unchanged. Add `expect fun createUpdaterDataStore():
   DataStore<Preferences>`; `androidMain actual` uses the same
   `PreferenceDataStoreFactory.createWithPath` pattern as step 1, name `"updater"`, plus
   `BuildConfig.VERSION_CODE` (read in `mobile`, passed in) for `installedVersionCode`; `iosMain
   actual` mirrors step 1's iOS seam. `swole/app/mobile/.../di/` gains a small `@Provides`
   function supplying the Android `DataStore<Preferences>` and `BuildConfig.VERSION_CODE` to the
   shared constructor, the same way step 1 wires `SettingsRepository`. `checkForUpdate`'s `SyncApi`
   parameter stays the Retrofit-era type from `sync/SyncApi.kt` — #214 has not landed a
   shared `SyncApi` at the point this issue lands, and this issue does not require it — so no
   further seam is needed here; `checkForUpdate`'s existing `response.code()`/`response.body()`
   calls are unchanged.
3. Move `data/repo/CoachRepository.kt` (70 lines) to
   `shared/src/commonMain/kotlin/dev/senki/swole/data/repo/CoachRepository.kt`, replacing its
   `context.filesDir`/`context.assets.open(...)` file access with an injected
   `expect class CoachFiles { fun bundleFile(): CoachBundleFile; fun readBundledAsset(): String }`
   seam, where `CoachBundleFile` is a small `expect class` wrapping a platform path with `exists():
   Boolean`, `readText(): String`, `writeText(text: String)` and `renameTo(target:
   CoachBundleFile): Boolean` (the four operations `load()`/`save()` need — matching the atomic-
   rename-then-swap shape `save()` already uses at `tmp.renameTo(bundleFile)`). `androidMain
   actual class CoachFiles(private val context: Context)` wraps `context.filesDir`/
   `context.assets`; `androidMain actual class CoachBundleFile` wraps `java.io.File`. `iosMain
   actual class CoachFiles` wraps `NSFileManager.defaultManager` and the app bundle's resource
   path for the bundled seed asset; `iosMain actual class CoachBundleFile` wraps `NSFileManager`
   read/write/move calls — this target is never executed on the Windows CI runner today, so this
   actual is unverified by any run in this PR. `CoachRepository`'s public API (`bundle:
   Flow<CoachBundle>`, `load()`, `save(raw: String)`, `templateForDay(...)`) and its exact
   sequencing (parse before writing the temp file, so a malformed bundle never overwrites the
   last-good one; atomic rename over the live file; `_bundle` `MutableStateFlow` updated only after
   the write succeeds) are unchanged. `swole/app/mobile/.../di/` gains a small `@Provides` function
   supplying the Android `CoachFiles(context)` and constructing the shared `CoachRepository` from
   it.

## Acceptance

- `./gradlew :shared:compileKotlinAndroid` succeeds with `SettingsRepository`, `UpdateRepository`
  and `CoachRepository` all in `commonMain`.
- `data/repo/CoachRepositoryTest.kt` (today under `swole/app/mobile/src/test/kotlin/dev/senki/
  swole/data/repo/`, Robolectric + Truth) moves to `shared/src/androidUnitTest/kotlin/dev/senki/
  swole/data/repo/` — it stays Android-only (Truth and Robolectric have no Kotlin/Native artifact)
  rather than `commonTest` — with its three `CoachRepository(ctx)` call sites updated to construct
  through the new `androidMain` `CoachFiles` seam, and passes with the same three assertions
  (`loadsBundledAssetWhenNoFileYet`, `saveReplacesBundleAtomically`,
  `invalidSaveThrowsAndKeepsPriorBundle`).
- A new `SettingsRepositoryTest` (none exists today) constructs the shared `SettingsRepository`
  with a fake `DataStore<Preferences>` (`PreferenceDataStoreFactory.create` over a temp file, the
  same per-test-isolated-store pattern `update/UpdateRepositoryTest.kt` already uses) and asserts
  `serverUrl`/`token` default to `SettingsRepository.DEFAULT_SERVER_URL`/`""` and round-trip through
  `setServerUrl`/`setToken`.
- `update/UpdateRepositoryTest.kt` stays in `mobile/src/test` unmodified and passes: it already
  constructs `UpdateRepository` through the same plain primary constructor this step keeps, so
  unlike `CoachRepositoryTest.kt` above it needs no call-site change to keep working against the
  now-shared type (it also calls `SyncApiFactory.create`, the Retrofit-era factory, which stays in
  `mobile` until #214 lands — this issue does not touch it). Its four existing assertions
  (`newerPublishedBuildSurfaces`, `equalOrOlderBuildStaysQuiet`, `notFoundClearsAnEarlierOffer`,
  `serverErrorKeepsTheCachedOffer`) are unaffected.
- `./gradlew :mobile:testDebugUnitTest` still passes; the small `@Provides` functions added to
  `mobile`'s DI modules compile and Hilt still resolves `SettingsRepository`/`UpdateRepository`/
  `CoachRepository` for every existing injection site.
- `uv run pytest -q --tb=short` and `uv run ruff check . ; uv run ruff format --check .` (from
  `server/`) stay green — this issue touches no Python.

## Blocked by

Blocked by #210
